WorkflowInfo.Xoml: <SequentialWorkflowActivity xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/workflow" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" x:Name="CustomWorkflow" x:Class="WorkflowDesignerControl.CustomWorkflow"> <CreateMemoryTable x:Name="certTable1" Description="Create certificate expiration table" description="Create certificate expiration table" TableName="certificates_expiration_dates" ColumnNumber="3" RowNumber="3" /> <GetRowsCount x:Name="getCertRowCount1" Description="Count certificates" description="Count certificates" ResultSet="%certTable1%" /> <GetDate x:Name="getCurrentDate1" Description="Get current date" description="Get current date" FuturePast="Current" TimeInterval="Days" TimeToAdd="0" DateFormat="MM/dd/yyyy" /> <WhileActivity x:Name="loopCerts1"> <SequenceActivity x:Name="whileSeq1"> <ExitWhile x:Name="exitWhile1" Counter="%getCertRowCount1%" /> <GetCellValue x:Name="getExpDate1" Description="Get expiration date" description="Get expiration date" ResultSet="%certTable1%" RowNumber="%loopCerts1%" ColumnNumber="Cert Dates" /> <GetCellValue x:Name="getServerName1" Description="Get server name" description="Get server name" ResultSet="%certTable1%" RowNumber="%loopCerts1%" ColumnNumber="Server" /> <DateDifference x:Name="dateDiff1" Description="Calculate days to expiry" description="Calculate days to expiry" FirstDate="%getCurrentDate1%" SecondDate="%getExpDate1%" ReturnFormat="Days" /> </SequenceActivity> </WhileActivity> </SequentialWorkflowActivity>
